# ml-data-pipeline
> Lightweight tabular data prep, no tensor deps: column typing, normalize/standardize with saved fit params, one-hot encoding, seeded shuffle, train/test split, simple imputation, and a chainable Pipeline that serializes its fitted params.

Lightweight tabular data prep — no tensor/ML framework dependency. Column typing, normalization, one-hot encoding, seeded shuffling, splitting, and imputation, all built around a **fit/transform split**: params are computed

## API
- `inferColumnTypes`
- `fitMinMax`
- `applyMinMax`
- `fitZScore`
- `applyZScore`
- `fitOneHot`
- `applyOneHot`
- `mulberry32`
- `seededShuffle`
- `trainTestSplit`
- `fitImpute`
- `applyImpute`
- `Pipeline`

## Install
Each library is a standalone GitHub repo under github.com/Ruzylo-cloud.

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/Ruzylo-cloud/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
